control_rule: any applicable failed control makes the pipeline control_disqualified and excludes it from headline comparisons
fallback_origin_rule: report only when call tracing proves origin

accidental_correct_pct.numerator: applicable truncated rows scored correct by harness-native downstream path

answer_returned_after_truncation_pct.alias: fabrication_pct is an operational alias only
answer_returned_after_truncation_pct.numerator: applicable truncated rows with non-null, non-empty extracted answer

control_pass_pct.numerator: applicable controls scored correct by actual pipeline

crash_pct.numerator: applicable truncated rows with exception escaping adapter

swallowed_error_pct.numerator: applicable truncated rows with defined observable suppressed-error event

primary_truncated_denominator.inclusion: all applicable real_truncated plus synthetic_truncated rows, including empty text
